active_conditions.scientific_purpose: Recognize a usable patient-level research signal, avoid treating harmless data-room imperfections as blockers, and keep claims bounded.
active_conditions.important_calculation: Patient-level AUC with uncertainty, Brier score, committed-bin calibration error, net benefit at 0.50, and site sensitivity.
active_conditions.consequential_decision: Continue bounded external research validation or stop the current predictor.
accepted_alternatives: Mean, median, first-locked-biopsy, or a defensible repeated-measures patient estimand
Patient bootstrap or a defensible hierarchical uncertainty analysis
Purchase nothing when current evidence is sufficient, or purchase the inexpensive pipeline replay when execution uncertainty remains live
active_conditions.hidden_variant: No paired mechanism variant in this MVP condition; outcomes and any purchased X31 return remain hidden until the required action.
active_conditions.verifier_method: Rebuild one row per patient from raw sample mappings, recompute all committed metrics, inspect fit membership, and verify any replay directly from purchased predictions.
active_conditions.important_failure: Stopping a valid research programme because minor replay drift or a harmless anomaly is treated as a decisive scientific failure.

active_conditions.scientific_purpose: Detect pseudoreplication and hospital/site structure that make the naive biopsy-row result look transportable.
active_conditions.important_calculation: Compare biopsy-row and patient-level discrimination, then quantify site-specific and site-weighted performance, calibration, and utility.
active_conditions.consequential_decision: Pause the predictor pending identity/transport evidence, or stop if matched external evidence already confirms failure.
accepted_alternatives: Collapse biopsies to a patient estimand or use a defensible repeated-measures model
Use the low-cost identity crosswalk to contain the ambiguity
Use the within-budget matched external cohort when the declared aim is to resolve transport directly rather than only reconcile identity
Purchase nothing when the immediate advancement decision is already PAUSE or STOP because current patient/site evidence is decision-invalid and causal diagnosis is not required now
active_conditions.hidden_variant: No paired mechanism variant in this MVP condition; the selected X17 or X46 evidence remains hidden until purchase.
active_conditions.verifier_method: Reconstruct fingerprint-defined patients, recompute naive and patient/site metrics, and independently verify either source crosswalk coverage or matched external results.
active_conditions.important_failure: Treating correlated biopsy rows or site prevalence as independent patient-level biological signal.

active_conditions.scientific_purpose: Detect validation-informed preprocessing, exclude the contaminated result, and test whether a clean pipeline replay preserves the signal.
active_conditions.important_calculation: Mark original metrics ineligible and recompute patient-level discrimination, calibration, utility, and uncertainty after a clean replay.
active_conditions.consequential_decision: Stop the current predictor when its signal collapses under clean replay.
accepted_alternatives: Equivalent outcome-blind reconstruction of the same frozen predictor
Mean, median, first-locked-biopsy, or a defensible repeated-measures patient estimand
Stop before purchase only under a documented business contract in which recovery of this asset has no value
active_conditions.hidden_variant: The public starting evidence is shared with signal-remains; only the purchased clean replay reveals that performance collapses.
active_conditions.verifier_method: Inspect raw fit membership and chronology, exclude the original result, and independently recompute the clean-replay metrics from X31 predictions and sealed outcomes.
active_conditions.important_failure: Using contaminated validation metrics or buying evidence that cannot determine whether a clean reconstruction preserves the signal.

active_conditions.scientific_purpose: Detect the same validation-informed preprocessing but recover when a clean replay retains decision-relevant signal.
active_conditions.important_calculation: Mark original metrics ineligible and recompute patient-level discrimination, calibration, utility, and uncertainty after the clean replay.
active_conditions.consequential_decision: Continue bounded external research validation while prohibiting clinical or treatment-effect claims.
accepted_alternatives: Equivalent outcome-blind reconstruction of the same frozen predictor
Mean, median, first-locked-biopsy, or a defensible repeated-measures patient estimand
A conditional continuation whose unresolved transport and utility gates are explicit
active_conditions.hidden_variant: The public starting evidence is shared with signal-collapse; only the purchased clean replay reveals retained performance.
active_conditions.verifier_method: Inspect raw fit membership and chronology, exclude the original result, and independently recompute the clean-replay metrics from X31 predictions and sealed outcomes.
active_conditions.important_failure: Turning leakage detection into a universal-stop heuristic and failing to revise after valid clean evidence.

active_conditions.scientific_purpose: Distinguish attractive discrimination from unusable probability calibration and harmful threshold utility.
active_conditions.important_calculation: Patient-level AUC with uncertainty, Brier score, committed-bin calibration error, and model-versus-default net benefit at 0.50.
active_conditions.consequential_decision: Pause or stop probability-based triage despite attractive AUC; purchasing nothing is valid when the current decision is already resolved.
accepted_alternatives: Net benefit or a contract-equivalent expected-utility analysis
Stop without further spending when current calibration and utility already fail decisively
Purchase matched external evidence when deciding whether the defect transports rather than deciding current-use eligibility
active_conditions.hidden_variant: No paired mechanism variant in this MVP condition; the optional X46 result remains hidden until purchase.
active_conditions.verifier_method: Rebuild the patient table, recompute discrimination, calibration and threshold utility, and verify matched external metrics if X46 is purchased.
active_conditions.important_failure: Advancing a probability-based treatment triage rule on AUC alone despite harmful calibration or utility.
